idea-plugin.name: GgNotes
idea-plugin.description:
GgNotes shows the overviews that the gigagit CLI (gg) stores for a repository: an AI agent's markdown document whose links are anchors into the code at one commit, plus remarks on exact lines. The same overview the user sees in gg, read from the same files on disk, with no gg running.

  • The GgNotes tool window lists the overviews of the open repository, grouped by commit (HEAD's first, then newest).
  • Selecting one renders its document; anchors are links numbered in document order, with next/previous-anchor actions.
  • An anchor opens the file at the overview's commit, scrolled to the line with the range selected; the banner above the editor goes back to the overview.
  • The overview's remarks appear as boxes above their lines while it is open.

Read-only: the plugin never writes gg's store.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.3

  • Double-click a row to open it with the document taking the whole window (the Document Only state; the toolbar toggle or Close brings the list back). The Delete key on a selected row is the context menu's Delete: a confirmation first, then the deletion.

0.3.2

  • The document breathes: paragraphs, headings, lists and code blocks have space between them, and a hard line break inside a paragraph (the "Lead. text" lines agents write one under the other) gets a little air of its own, less than a paragraph's.

0.3.1

  • Follows gg's session-docs rulings of 2026-10-19: gg session files rows of an overview carry author, created and anchors; file_focus on a document id written a moment ago re-reads the directory once before refusing (gg posts the focus right after the rename), and answers focused overview <id> "<title>" as gg's own window does; a retired verb is refused before any other check.

0.3.0

  • An agent's temporary overviews and notes are now FILES in the worktree's session docs directory (gg's session-docs contract: <inbox>/docs/<id>.md and <id>.toml), shown by every gg reader of the worktree. The tool window's Session group lists the overview files newest first (title, author, age, anchor count, on screen); note files are boxes on the editors of their file, placed from their own lines and following edits. The directory is re-read every 2 s and on every change; a replaced file is replaced in place, a removed one goes. Nothing is created or deleted by the IDE on its own.
  • Delete on a session row unlinks the overview's file; the editor's menu gets Delete Session Note and Delete All Session Notes on This File. Closing stays local: the file and the row stay.
  • The in-memory note_* / overview_* steer verbs are retired: a gg that still sends them is told <verb> is retired: write the file (gg session note|overview add) and the IDE raises a notice. gg session files lists the session overviews under their document ids; file_focus takes one.

0.2.11

  • Rows say what they refer to: a short grey badge after an overview or review title reads PR #7, branch main (still at that commit) or was main (the branch moved on), range, preview, pair or working; a plain commit row has none. Group headers are short: the commit, PR #n when a commit carries one pull request's records, Working tree, and In memory for an agent's session overviews.

0.2.10

  • Close leaves the window ready for the next click: no row stays selected, so the same row can be opened again; the document half goes away and the list takes the whole window; Document Only is disabled while nothing is open.

0.2.9

  • The tool window is shown as Overviews on the stripe and in its header. Its id stays GgNotes, so saved layouts keep working.

0.2.8

  • A Document Only toggle on the tool window's toolbar hides the list so the document takes the whole window; press it again to show the list.

0.2.7

  • The tree's context menu item is now Delete on every row; the confirmation still says what goes (gg's store for stored rows, only this IDE session for an in-memory overview).

0.2.6

  • In-memory overviews (gg session overview add --to ide) are rows of the tool window: a This session group above the commits lists them, marked in memory and on screen, with their anchor count and unresolved links. Click one to show it, right-click to drop it from the session. They were never in gg's store and vanish when the project closes.

0.2.5

  • Right-click any row of the notes tree for Remove from gg Store: an overview, a review (with the notes shown under it), a file's notes, one note thread, one reply, everything under a commit, or a worktree's live records. After a confirmation the plugin hands the deletion to gg itself (gg batch with note rm / overview rm), so gg's own rules apply and the store files are never rewritten by the IDE. Needs gg on PATH, or the system property ggnotes.gg pointing at it.

0.2.4

  • The notes tree above the document takes only the height its rows need, up to a third of the tool window; a longer list scrolls inside that share. Dragging the divider keeps your size for the session.

0.2.3

  • gg session navigate <gg://…?overview=<id>> --to ide opens the stored overview in the tool window (a ?review= link opens the review), as gg's own window does, instead of only revealing the commit.

0.2.2

  • When an anchor becomes current, the overview keeps a few lines of context above it instead of pinning it to the top edge, and does not scroll at all when the anchor is already on screen.

0.2.1

  • Opening a file at a commit loads its content in the background; newer IDEs reported GitContentRevision.getContentAsBytes() should not be called from EDT when the editor asked for it on the UI thread.

0.2.0

  • Reviews, line notes with replies and live notes on the working tree, read from the same gg store.
  • The IDE is a gg session … --to ide target: an agent in a terminal can open a file at a line or range, highlight lines, leave temporary remarks and show an in-memory overview in the tool window, with no gg running (the in-memory part was replaced by session docs files in 0.3.0).

0.1.0

  • First version: the overview viewer (tool window, document, anchors, remarks).
